name: A static caller is refused a runtime-added member

input.source_text: class A { public fun base() -> Integer { 1 } } let added = A.define_method(:extra) { 9 }; A.new().extra()

applicability.reason: Supported. C045 makes the declared static spine immutable for a revision, and META-C045 keeps a runtime-added member out of static API, so a STATIC call site reaching one is refused while the reflective path stays permitted after publication - which was already the case and is what the earlier measurement got wrong by calling `m.call` instead of `Reflection::Class.invoke`. The static half is now implemented: the analyser checks a direct `A.new().member()` against the members A declares. It is deliberately bounded to a Class declared in this program that extends nothing and composes no Module, since an inherited or composed member is not in that list, and universal protocol selectors are exempt because every value answers them. A receiver reached any other way is left alone: a wrong rejection is worse than a missed one.
